recipes.title: Beef Pot Roast Recipe
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes (peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces Yukon Gold)
4  large carrots (peeled and cut on the diagonal into 2-inch pieces)
recipes.description: Beef pot roast recipe, made the classic way. I sear a well marbled chuck roast until it has a deep, caramelized crust, then let it braise low and slow in one pot with potatoes, carrots, red wine and fresh herbs until it is fork tender. It takes about four hours in the oven, but only fifteen minutes of hands on prep, and the pot does the rest of the work for you.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup with Chicken Thighs
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 2 pounds skin-on bone-in chicken thighs (trimmed of excess skin or fat)
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
2  carrots (peeled and cut into ½-inch pieces)
recipes.description: Chicken noodle soup with chicken thighs is the version I make when I want the broth to actually taste like something, not just warm you up. I sear bone in, skin on thighs before anything else hits the pot, which is what gives this soup its deep, savory base instead of a thin, watery one. Between the seared chicken, a simple mirepoix, and tender egg noodles, it's ready in about an hour, most of it hands off while the soup simmers.
